perf.summary: The twiddle factor in the butterfly is regenerated by repeated 'wn = wn*w % mod', creating a long serial dependency chain and extra mults; the precomputed roots[] table already holds every power and could be indexed directly.
perf.currentCost: Inner loop does one extra multiply-mod per butterfly to advance wn, and the wn chain is a serial dependency that the multiplier of the actual butterfly v=a[..]*wn must wait on, lengthening the critical path and blocking ILP/vectorization.
perf.proposedChange: Index the global roots table directly: for stage 'len', the j-th twiddle is roots[(n/len)*j] (since roots[k] = root^k and w = roots[n/len]). Replace 'long v = a[i+j+half]*wn%mod; ...; wn=wn*w%mod' with a precomputed stride: twiddle = roots[stepIndex]; stepIndex += n/len. This removes the per-iteration wn multiply and breaks the dependency chain.
perf.rationale: Eliminates one multiply-mod per butterfly (size/2 * log size of them) and removes a serial dependency, letting Burst overlap butterflies. roots already spans size entries so all needed powers exist.
perf.risk: Index arithmetic must be exact: roots[k] = root^k with root = g^((mod-1)/size); roots[(n/len)*j] equals w^j only when n==size (the only caller). For the inverse pass invRoots is passed as 'roots', and invRoots[k]=invRoot^k holds the same property — safe. Guard: this identity assumes NttForward is always called with n==size; the current code always does.
